Every receipt recorded  -  Every M-Pesa transaction is logged with the subscriber, the amount, the timestamp, and the channel. Month-end closes itself.
Revenue you can close  -  Your collections report shows what came in, from whom, and through which channel. No spreadsheet reconciliation.

title: One device. One subscriber. No sharing.
intro: Lock each PPPoE or hotspot session to a specific IP and MAC address. One subscriber, one connection. No workarounds.
problem: A subscriber shares their credentials with the whole apartment block. You're providing bandwidth for 10 people. You're billing for one. You notice when your revenue per subscriber doesn't add up.
points: IP binding  -  Assign a fixed IP to a specific subscriber. Their device always gets the same address. Useful for remote access, fixed services, and fraud prevention.
MAC binding  -  Tie a PPPoE or hotspot session to the device's hardware address. If the MAC doesn't match, the session doesn't open.
Credential sharing blocked  -  Even if a subscriber shares their username and password, MAC binding stops anyone else from connecting on those credentials.
Easy management  -  View and update bindings from the subscriber record. Change a binding when a customer gets a new router in seconds.

title: Prepay credit that applies itself at renewal.
intro: Subscribers top up their wallet. Renewals draw from it automatically. Fewer overdue accounts, fewer reminder calls.
problem: A subscriber wants to pay for two months in advance. You take the payment, write it in a spreadsheet, and hope you remember to apply it next month. You forget. They disconnect. They complain.
points: Wallet top-up  -  Subscribers add credit via M-Pesa. It sits in their account and applies automatically at the next billing cycle.
Automatic renewal draw  -  When a subscription is due, the system checks the wallet first. If the balance covers it, it renews without any action from the subscriber or your team.
Balance visibility  -  Subscribers see their wallet balance in the self-service portal. No guessing, no calls asking "how much do I have left?"
Partial payments handled  -  If the wallet balance doesn't cover the full amount, the shortfall is invoiced separately. The subscriber knows exactly what's due.

title: Subscribers refer friends. You grow without spending on ads.

points: Unique referral links  -  Every subscriber gets their own link to share. When someone signs up through it, the referral is attributed automatically.
Configurable rewards  -  Set the reward yourself: account credit, a free month, a cash payout via M-Pesa. The system applies it when the referred subscriber activates.
Referral tracking  -  See who referred whom, how many referrals each subscriber has made, and which ones converted. One report.
Reward status  -  Subscribers see their referrals and reward status in their portal. They know what's pending, what's paid, and what's still to come.

Secure data separation  -  Subscriber data, payment records, and network configs are isolated per branch. Each environment is secure and independent.
